Tie verification with half-up rounding:

- \(n=105:\ 0.7\cdot105=73.5\), so \(R(73.5)=74\).
- \(n=107:\ 0.7\cdot75=52.5\), so \(R(52.5)=53\) under half-up.
- \(n=115:\ 0.7\cdot115=80.5\), so \(R(80.5)=81\).
- There are no exact \(0.5\) ties for \(0.49n\) with \(100\le n\le119\), since \(49n/100\) ends in \(.5\) only when \(n\equiv50\pmod{100}\).

Therefore, under half-up rounding, the complete discrepancy set is:

\[
\boxed{\{101,105,107,111,115\}}.
\]
